query: SELECT * FROM consensus.inflation_expectations WHERE source='cnb_fmie' ORDER BY survey_date,horizon_value,metric
source_date_kind: survey_date is a nominal month-start label, not publication time
source_retrieval_field: fetched_at is the original database retrieval timestamp, not historical release
target_definition: Headline CPI year-on-year percentage at survey_month plus horizon_months; mean of analysts
